related_questions.snippet: Can men also use the AirSense 10 for her? related_questions.question: Is the ResMed AirSense 10 being discontinued?

text_blocks.snippet: Yes, the ResMed AirSense 10 is being discontinued in favor of newer models, specifically the AirSense 11. While it was a popular and effective CPAP machine, ResMed has shifted its focus to the newer model. The AirSense 10 was originally released in 2014 and has been superseded by the AirSense 11, which offers updated features and technology.
